text.p: Envirodyne Industries Inc said it has received an offer from Heico Holdings Inc to acquire the company for $8.50 a share -- plus additional cash depending on the final damage award in a patent infringement suit.

The offer is the second from a company affiliated with Envirodyne director Michael Heisley. On June 23, an independent committeee of the board of directors rejected an $8.50 a share offer from HK Acquisitions Corp.

The additional cash would be based on damages awarded in a patent infringment lawsuit filed by Envirodyne's Viskase Corp against American National Can Co. In November, 1996, a jury awarded $102.4 million, a verdict American National Can is challenging in post-trial motions, Envirodyne said.

The Heico offer would give Envirodyne shareholders 75 percent of proceeds received by the company in payment of the judgment after deduction of all fairly attributed costs in excess of $60 million, divided by the number shares of common stock now outstanding or issuable under stock options, Envirodyne said.
The offer requires a repsonse from the company by the close of business August 18 and includes a $4 million break-up fee Envirodyne would have to pay Heico.
Envirodyne said the offer will be submitted to a committee of independent directors of the company. Envirodyne shares were down 1/2 at 7-1/8 Monday.
